meta.description: Log of koolestpro-browseract-weekly scheduled task runs. Each entry records which rotation slot ran, how many leads were pushed to KoolestFlow, and any errors, so Ridwan can audit without opening KoolestFlow every week.

runs.note: Discovery + enrichment + scoring succeeded (5 prospects, all Qualified, fit 75-100), but the push did NOT land. The Vercel deployment accepted POST /api/state and reported 'Pushed 5 new prospect(s), total now 5', yet a follow-up GET /api/state returned 0 prospects - the serverless backend is not persisting writes. Ridwan's real prospect data lives on the local instance (KOOLESTFLOW_LOCAL_BASE_URL), which the cloud sandbox cannot reach. The 5 scored prospects were saved to .ai-workflow/pending-push/2026-W36_lekki-fashion-boutique.json; re-push with push_prospects_file.py --ignore-ledger from Ridwan's own terminal (no BrowserAct credits re-spent). Also: enrichment timed out for Brumsluxe Fashion and Polo Avenue, so their 'no website / Build track' tag is unverified. Rotation was still advanced to index 1.
